property_summary: For any non-empty `_tos` array, calling transfer(...) on the correct contract returns true (completes successfully); the mutant inserts an unconditional revert after the require and therefore will revert (call fails) for at least some admissible inputs (any with _tos.length>0).
change_summary: Insert a revert() right after the require so that transfer always reverts before making any external calls, differing from original which may succeed.
